name: zensu-codex-evals
description: Eval/e2e tooling for the zensu-codex plugin (promptfoo, codex-exec wrapper). The plugin itself is pure bash + markdown; Node is used ONLY by the --live eval path — the deterministic no-arg suite never needs it.

scripts.eval:tdd: cd evals/tdd && npx --no-install promptfoo eval -c promptfooconfig.yaml
